activity.notes: The Tyrolean uprising against Bavarian and Napoleonic rule began on 9 April 1809. Hofer became its best-known military-political leader and after the August victory directed the country's military and civil administration. His organized leadership phase ended with the defeat of the renewed uprising on 1 November 1809. ATLAS therefore models Hofer as active in the Tyrolean Rebellion rather than as a sovereign ruler of a separate Tyrol state.

sources.title: HOFER, Andreas — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani records the uprising beginning on 9 April 1809, Hofer's leadership and direction of Tyrol's military and civil administration, and his final defeat on 1 November.
